reason: Earlier V2 Wide development scores are superseded for system selection because arXiv-looking identifiers were regex-extracted from the complete Atom feed. Dev-2 additionally exposed generic/function-word query anchors and same-backend agreement-first ranking that could discard raw gold. Dev-3 corrects only these diagnosed classes.

implementation.candidate_identity_rule: Only parsed Atom entry identities may enter scorer candidates; returned scorer IDs must not exceed max_results.

systems.candidate_selection: identical round-robin interleaving across each system's three query families
systems.task_closure_authority: disabled; acquisition development cannot certify closure

development_eligibility_rule.interpretation: This is a development-selection gate only. Passing it permits execution of a separately pre-frozen fresh confirmation; it is never itself publication confirmation.

stop_rule: This is the final acquisition-development iteration. If Dev-3 fails its frozen eligibility rule, do not create Dev-4 on this 24-task slice; terminate the V2 acquisition widening attempt at a stable non-promotion terminal.
forbidden: using any Dev-3 outcome as confirmatory evidence
changing the 24 development tasks after outcome access
relaxing the development eligibility rule after outcome access
admitting arXiv IDs found only in summaries or feed metadata outside entry identity
calling same-backend query formulations independent routes
creating a fourth acquisition tuning iteration on this development slice if Dev-3 is non-eligible
